output.scope_note: The paper is a DFT study of native defects in the Li-ion solid electrolyte candidate Li4BN3H10. It quotes one literature conductivity value for that material, so it is in scope, but the only record is data_origin literature_cited.

records.evidence_quote: The material was reported to have a conductivity of 2 × 10−4 S/cm at room temperature and an activation energy of 0.26 eV.8
records.notes: Value is quoted from Matsuo et al. (ref. 8) in the introduction, not measured or computed in this paper. The 0.26 eV activation energy is also quoted from ref. 8 and is stated in the same sentence. The conductivity is not specified as total, bulk or grain-boundary.
